g.text: What was measured in each condition?
Main sample: 10 chains per condition; one fresh context per four-role chain; 24 game weeks.
Pipeline response = average of 8 matched scenario slopes: order decrease / increase in outstanding cases.
Total cost = sum of (0.5 × inventory + backlog) over 4 roles × 24 weeks.
Order variance = mean of 4 within-role sample variances (24 weeks, denominator 23).
Bullwhip = mean of role order variance / own chain's final-consumer demand variance, then mean across chains.
Small dots: individual chains. Diamonds and numbers: condition means. Fictional seconds; actual model runtime unrestricted.
